BiblicalUsage: The writer to the Hebrews tells his readers to remember the former days, when they endured a great fight of afflictions after they were illuminated. The word means a struggle, the contest itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that remembering past endurance is fuel for present faith, because the God who carried them through the fight has not changed.
